about_html:
Kstore was founded on a simple conviction: the physical objects that populate our daily rituals should bring enduring calm, effortless utility, and architectural stillness to the modern dwelling.

Frustrated by disposable flat-pack furniture that degraded after two moves, and luxury design galleries priced beyond reason, we set out to build an honest bridge. We collaborate directly with multi-generational timber workshops in Småland, Sweden, and Vermont, USA.

Every millimeter of our furniture is engineered against sensory distraction. From concealed wire channels to whisper-soft drawer runners, our pieces quiet the home environment.

Our Three Foundational Commitments: - 100% FSC-Certified Hardwoods: We harvest exclusively from regenerative forests, working in kiln-dried solid white oak, plantation teak, and European ash. Never synthetic veneer or disposable fiberboard. - Direct Workshop Craft: By bypassing wholesale markups and third-party distributors, we reinvest directly into master joinery, non-toxic plant-based finishes, and carbon-neutral transit. - Ten-Year Enduring Life: We engineer each joint with mortise-and-tenon integrity so that our pieces become family heirlooms rather than landfill waste.

"Good design is not what you add, but what can no longer be removed to achieve perfect stillness." — Kstore Design Studio
faq_html:
White-Glove Shipping & Fulfillment

Q: What are your delivery schedules and shipping rates?

We provide complimentary white-glove shipping on all orders over $150 across the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom. For smaller parcels, a flat delivery fee of $15 applies at checkout. In-stock timber furnishings typically arrive within 4 to 8 business days.

Q: How does white-glove home placement work?

Our specialized couriers contact you 24 hours prior to schedule a 2-hour delivery window. Our team unpacks your furniture in your room of choice, inspects all joinery tolerances, and removes all protective packaging for eco-responsible recycling.

Q: Can I inspect tracking milestones in real time?

Yes. Every order generates a persistent tracking permalink and tracking token. You can track real-time courier milestones anytime via our live tracking portal or your patron account dashboard.

Organic Timber & Material Care

Q: Where is your timber sourced, and is it FSC-certified?

100% of our architectural timber is sustainably harvested and FSC-certified from regenerative forests in North America and Scandinavia. We work exclusively with kiln-dried solid white oak, plantation teak, and European ash.

Q: How should I maintain and clean solid oak furniture?

Dust gently using a dry, soft microfiber cloth. For deeper cleansing, wipe along the grain with a slightly damp cloth and mild natural soap. Avoid harsh chemical polishes, acetone, or abrasive scrubbers. We recommend conditioning with organic beeswax twice yearly.

30-Day In-Home Trial & Returns

Q: How does the 30-day in-home trial work?

We encourage you to live with our pieces in your natural light for 30 full days. If an essential does not completely harmonize with your space, contact our concierge (concierge@kstore.com) to schedule a complimentary pickup. We provide a 100% refund to your original payment method.

Q: What condition must returned items be in?

Items must remain in clean, unblemished condition free of structural damage or liquid stains. Our couriers provide pickup crates, so you do not need to save bulky original boxes.

10-Year Craft Warranty

Q: What does the 10-year craft warranty cover?

Our warranty covers all structural mortise-and-tenon joinery, internal hardware, soft-close drawer runners, and natural timber frame integrity under normal residential usage for 10 years from the delivery date.
privacy_html:
At Kstore, client privacy and data integrity are fundamental principles. This document outlines how we collect, safeguard, and respect your personal information across our storefront, fit assistant, and white-glove logistics.

1. Information We Collect We collect only the information essential to providing exceptional architectural home goods: - Order & Delivery Details: Your full name, delivery address, phone number, and email address to coordinate white-glove couriers and delivery alerts. - Secure Payment Information: Payment credentials are processed directly through Stripe's certified Level 1 PCI-DSS infrastructure. We never store or view your full credit card numbers. - Spatial Dimensions (Fit Assistant): Nook and room dimensions provided in the Fit Assistant are used exclusively in real time to calculate ergonomic clearances and are never sold.

2. Zero Third-Party Data Broker Sales We maintain an uncompromising anti-tracking pledge: - We never sell, monetize, rent, or trade your personal information, contact records, or browsing habits to third-party data brokers or advertising networks. Ever.

3. Cryptographic Security Standards - All storefront interactions, credentials, and financial checkouts are encrypted using modern TLS 1.3 cryptographic protocols with HSTS enforcement.

4. Your Client Rights & Data Portability - You possess the absolute right to inspect the personal data we store, request immediate correction, or request complete account erasure. - To request data deletion or privacy inquiries, contact our Privacy Concierge anytime at concierge@kstore.com.
terms_html:
Welcome to Kstore. These terms govern the acquisition, delivery, trial, and preservation of living essentials purchased through our catalog.

1. Acquisition & Commercial Orders - By placing an order, you confirm you are at least 18 years of age and authorized to execute payment. - All acquisitions are subject to stock availability and address verification. If any discrepancy occurs, our concierge will notify you within 24 hours.

2. Natural Material Characteristics - Every piece of timber develops its own organic fingerprint. Natural variations in grain orientation, medullary rays, and warm honey undertones are authentic hallmarks of genuine solid hardwood, not manufacturing defects.

3. White-Glove Logistics & Inspection Protocols - Timber furnishings are delivered via specialized white-glove couriers. - Our team will place the piece in your room of choice and inspect joinery tolerances alongside you before completing sign-off. - Any transit damage noted during unboxing will be resolved immediately with a priority replacement or repair.

4. 30-Day Complimentary In-Home Trial - We encourage you to experience our pieces in your natural living environment for 30 full days. - If you decide the piece does not suit your space, contact concierge@kstore.com to schedule complimentary pickup and receive a 100% refund.

5. Ten-Year Structural Craft Warranty - All mortise-and-tenon structural joints, internal drawer runners, and timber frames are backed by our signature 10-year craft warranty against material defects under normal residential living conditions.
